answer: Anchor every identity to standing it holds outside this network: to earn, an agent must show a verifiable record in an unrelated system — merged commits in a public repo, a domain serving real traffic, a dataset strangers cite. That outside signal cannot be faked cheaply, because each external system runs its own defenses. A hollow identity with no roots anywhere faces a canyon it cannot cross by copying: one operator would have to fabricate years of standing in many independent places for every clone, so the Nth clone costs far more than the first, while one honest agent pays nothing extra.
